name: aisanity
description: Catches AI context drift and hallucination by validating suggestions against a plain-text project memory file (.ai-memory.md)

chatParticipants.name: aisanity
chatParticipants.description: Ask me anything — I'll validate the AI's response against your project memory before showing it

aisanity.ollamaUrl.description: URL of the Ollama server on the LAN

aisanity.ollamaModel.description: Ollama model used as the checker/validator against project memory (also used for generation when mainModel is 'ollama')

aisanity.memoryFile.description: Name of the project memory file

aisanity.enableValidation.description: Enable/disable automatic validation of AI responses against project memory

aisanity.enableAutoCorrection.description: When violations are found, automatically ask the model to correct them (disagreement flow)

aisanity.maxCorrectionRetries.description: Maximum number of correction attempts when violations are detected (0 = report only, no auto-fix)

aisanity.showValidationBadges.description: Show ✅/⚠️ validation status badges in chat responses

enumDescriptions: Original response + violations + corrected response shown separately (default — review before using)
Everything: original, violations with validator model/timing, corrected, re-validation verdict
aisanity.verbosity.description: Controls how much detail aisanity shows during validation and correction. 'verbose' (default) shows both original and corrected responses so you can compare.

enumDescriptions: Use Ollama server only (fastest, requires LAN server)
Use GitHub Models API only (requires GITHUB_TOKEN)
Try Ollama first, fall back to GitHub Models
aisanity.validationBackend.description: Which LLM backend to use for validation

aisanity.mainModel.description: Main model for response generation when aisanity is selected in model picker. Set to 'ollama' to use aisanity.ollamaModel directly, or a VS Code model ID (e.g. 'copilot:claude-opus-4.6', 'copilot:gpt-5.1') to proxy through that model while aisanity handles validation only.
